evals.prompt: Build me a PPTB tool in React that lists all solutions in the connected Dataverse environment.
evals.expected_output: The tool is scaffolded with the official yo pptb generator (React), @pptb/types is installed, solutions are read through window.dataverseAPI with errors surfaced via toolboxAPI.utils.showNotification, the package.json manifest follows references/manifest.md, and pptb-validate is run before the debug instructions are given.
expectations: Scaffolds with yo pptb (or npx --package yo --package generator-pptb -- yo pptb <name>) instead of hand-writing the Vite project
Installs @pptb/types as a dev dependency
Reads the solutions through window.dataverseAPI, not a hand-built fetch with a bearer token
Wraps the API calls in try/catch and reports failures with toolboxAPI.utils.showNotification rather than alert() or console only
Writes the manifest with the nested configurations.repository and configurations.readmeUrl fields described in references/manifest.md
Runs npx pptb-validate (for example with --skip-url-checks) and fixes every error before moving on
Explains the debug loop: npm run dev-watch, Show Debug Menu, Load Local Tool pointed at the project root (not dist/), reload the tab after each rebuild

evals.prompt: My PPTB tool shows a blank tab when I load it in ToolBox, but npm run dev works fine in the browser.
evals.expected_output: The existing tool's vite.config.ts and built dist/index.html are inspected before any re-scaffolding; the cause is traced to module/ESM output or code-splitting, and the fix is an IIFE single-bundle build without type="module" script tags, following references/build-and-csp.md.
expectations: Reads the existing project (vite.config.ts, package.json, dist/index.html) before suggesting a fix, and doesn't re-scaffold the tool
Identifies <script type="module">, crossorigin attributes or code-split chunks as the likely cause of the blank tab inside PPTB
Proposes forcing the Rollup output to iife with inlineDynamicImports: true and stripping type="module" from the built HTML
Explains that npm run dev working in a browser tab doesn't prove the build loads inside PPTB
Asks the user to rebuild and reload the tool tab in PPTB to confirm, instead of claiming it's fixed

evals.prompt: My tool needs to call https://api.github.com to show release notes. What do I need to change?
evals.expected_output: A least-privilege cspExceptions entry for api.github.com is added to the manifest with the reason documented, following references/build-and-csp.md, and pptb-validate is re-run.
expectations: Adds a cspExceptions entry for the specific origin https://api.github.com under the connect-src directive
Doesn't use wildcards such as "*" or bare https:
Documents why the domain is needed (for example in the README's privacy or network section)
Re-runs pptb-validate after the manifest change

evals.prompt: Everything validates now. Publish version 1.0.0 of my tool to npm.
evals.expected_output: The publish sequence (build, pptb-validate clean, finalize-package, npm publish --access public, Tool Submission Form) is laid out, and explicit confirmation is requested before npm publish runs, because a published version can't be unpublished after 72 hours.
expectations: Runs or lists npm run build, pptb-validate and npm run finalize-package before publishing
Stops and asks for explicit confirmation, naming the package and version, before running npm publish
Says the step is irreversible (npm versions can't be unpublished after 72 hours)
Uses npm publish --access public for a scoped package
Mentions submitting the tool through the Tool Submission Form after publishing

evals.prompt: I get 'toolboxAPI is undefined' when I open my tool. How do I fix it?
evals.expected_output: It's explained that window.toolboxAPI only exists inside PPTB, so the tool is being run in a standalone browser tab, or the editor is missing the @pptb/types reference; the tool should be loaded through PPTB's Debug menu to test host APIs.
expectations: Explains that window.toolboxAPI is only defined when the tool runs inside PPTB, not in a normal browser tab
Mentions the /// <reference types="@pptb/types" /> directive (or @pptb/types) for editor typing errors
Suggests loading the tool through the Debug menu in PPTB to test host APIs
Doesn't suggest mocking or polyfilling toolboxAPI as a production fix

evals.prompt: Make my existing entity-picker tool launchable from other PPTB tools so they can get the selected table back.
evals.expected_output: The existing tool isn't re-scaffolded; references/invocation.md is used to add the pptb.config.json invocation contract (capabilities, prefill, returnTopic) and the toolboxAPI.invocation getLaunchContext/returnData runtime calls.
expectations: Reads the existing tool first and doesn't run yo pptb again
Reads references/invocation.md and adds an invocation block to pptb.config.json with capabilities, prefill and returnTopic
Uses toolboxAPI.invocation.getLaunchContext to read prefill data and returnData to send the selected table back
Doesn't add MCP or agent integration (references/agent-integration.md) unless asked
Notes that the feature may depend on the installed PPTB version and should be checked against it
